task: Write a Python function fetch_status(url) that GETs the URL and returns the JSON body, with a 5 second timeout.

constraints.text: HTTP client code uses httpx; the 'requests' library stays out of the codebase
constraints.why: the team standardized on httpx for connection pooling and HTTP/2 after requests caused a socket-exhaustion incident in March

constraints.text: every outbound network call carries an explicit timeout
constraints.why: a call with no timeout hung the deploy pipeline for 40 minutes during the March incident

checks.description: no explicit timeout on the network call
